name: Doki Doki No Happiness
storyline: One random morning, our protagonist is met with his dear friend sayori, and is offered a place, in the new Literature Club! For someone like the protagonist, this is an offer he really can't refuse. That being said, he can't shake this feeling of deja vu... then again, how could it get any worse?
summary: Doki Doki No Happiness is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that seeks to expand the game's original story, offering an alternative approach where psychological horror gives way to a lighter, more emotional experience. Unlike the dark plot of the base game, this mod introduces a storyline in which the characters can find true happiness, allowing the player to explore new paths and more positive endings.
